name: ember-nyc
description: EMBER — Emergency Management Body of Evidence & Resources (NYC)

scripts.test:regional: npm run build-config && node --test tests/regional-normalization.test.js tests/regional-geography.test.js tests/regional-observations.test.js && python3 -m unittest tests/test_regional_normalization.py tests/test_regional_geography.py tests/test_regional_observations.py
scripts.test:streamlit: python3 -m unittest tests/test_chat_state.py tests/test_esri_presentation.py tests/test_map_builder_presets.py tests/test_map_builder_state.py tests/test_regional_normalization.py tests/test_regional_geography.py tests/test_regional_observations.py
scripts.phase3:gate: npm run validate-config && npm run test:regional && npm run test:streamlit && npm run build && node scripts/validate-phase-3.js && PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX=/private/tmp/openember-phase3-pycache python3 -m py_compile streamlit/config_loader.py streamlit/regional_normalization.py streamlit/regional_geography.py streamlit/regional_observations.py streamlit/tidal_gauges.py streamlit/app.py && git diff --check
